revisions.reason: 2026-11-23 handleWheel modifier payload only: read current physical generic Shift/Ctrl with nonmutating peekKeyDownState instead of stale legacy booleans. The one-line change preserves focus routing, callbacks, invocation ownership, DirectInput delivery, deltas, coordinates, capture and queues. Accepted independent 864-case test remains unchanged; corrected native wheel fixture presses/releases real generic modifiers with sided metadata, independently verifies physical state, drains keyboard messages, and preserves all existing wheel assertions including flags15. No callback, continuation, timer, retained-reference or guest-entry changes; broader ownership remains pending.
